source: docs/vision/subcortical_memory_blueprint.md sections 10.3 (toy Monte Carlo) and its additional weak-cue stress test, transcribed before any P05 reproduction code existed

study_1.statistical_consistency_rule: each cell within 3 standard errors of the declared value, standard error measured from the same simulation (std of per-pair overlap / sqrt(1200)); consistent-but-not-exact is reported as NOT_EXACT_REPRODUCTION

study_2.tie_rule: equal overlap is a tie and is never credited as correct
study_2.statistical_consistency_rule: each declared proportion within 3 binomial standard errors sqrt(p(1-p)/3000) of the measured proportion
